findings.finding: Stop during awaiting a durable job claim can start new execution or sending after stop returns
findings.independentReproduction: Real externalBotDrain body with a gated NextJob produced sendCallsAfterStop=1
findings.resolution: Check stopped inside the existing job try/finally after claim; break prevents dispatch and cleanup removes newly registered actor. A committed running/sending claim becomes unknown on cold restart without replay.
